crew.overview: After David Kim's 16-year-old daughter goes missing, a local investigation is opened and a detective is assigned to the case. But 37 hours later and without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.
crew.title: Searching

details.biography: Nina Kramer is an Emmy winning writer, director, producer, and comedian based in Los Angeles, CA. She divides her time freelance directing (Hollywood Records, FUJIFILM, Chevron, Amazon Prime, Youtube Premium, etc.), acting, and performing at night with her sketch team, The Matriarchy, or doing stand up. Nina is managed by Ryan Casey at MUTINY and legally represented by Ginsburg Daniels Kallis LLC. Additionally, she is signed with SixTwentySix Productions for commercials and music videos.
details.name: Nina Kramer
